a1
Jacob looked up and saw Esau coming with four hundred men. He arranged his family in order, with Rachel and Joseph last.
a2
Then he went ahead of them and bowed to the ground seven times as he came near his brother.
b1
But Esau ran to meet him. He embraced him, fell on his neck, and kissed him. And they wept.
b2
Esau saw the women and children: who are these? Jacob said: the children God has graciously given me.
c1
Esau said: I have enough, my brother. Keep what is yours.
c2
Jacob said: please accept my gift. To see your face is like seeing the face of God, since you received me so kindly.
d1
Esau accepted it, and returned to Seir. Jacob traveled on slowly, at the pace of his children and flocks.
e1
He came safely to Shechem, bought a piece of land, and built an altar there.
h1
Jacob prepared for the worst: gifts, a plan, and seven bows.
h2
Esau did not wait for any of it. He ran to Jacob, and they wept.
h3
The brother Jacob feared was the first to run.
h4
Today, take one step toward someone you have been avoiding.
i
Who do you need to make peace with?
